Steamboat Springs, Colorado · stay

Hotels in Steamboat Springs for cyclists

Places to stay in Steamboat Springs when you are in town to ride. Picked for being near the riding, easy with a bike, or cheap. Book early for event weekends. Rooms go first.

For: SBT GRVL.

Hotels in Steamboat Springs for cyclists, listed

  1. Rabbit Ears Motel

    $$ · 201 Lincoln Avenue, Steamboat Springs, CO 80487

    Family-run downtown motel since 1953, a few blocks from the SBT GRVL start; parking for bikes.

  2. The Nordic Lodge

    $ · 1036 Lincoln Avenue, Steamboat Springs, CO 80477

    Budget downtown motel one block from the river and the start.

  3. The Bristol Hotel

    $$ · 917 Lincoln Ave, Steamboat Springs, CO 80487

    Small historic hotel in the middle of downtown, walking distance to Yampa Street.

  4. Gravity Haus Steamboat

    $$$ · 2304 Apres Ski Way, Steamboat Springs, CO 80487

    Ski-in/ski-out at the mountain base, about three miles from the start; built for outdoor athletes.
